description: Platform, security and privacy (Part G, Req 30-32), the metrics overview (Req 33), demo readiness (Req 34), and a final frontend polish pass so the whole website presents as a cohesive, professional green/white + forest + Mussoorie hill-town product. This feature closes the loop: authentication + RBAC across every page/endpoint, guest PII protection, audit logging + secrets handling, the clickable metrics home, and the single documented demo command + scripted scenario.
steps: Auth_Service (Req 30) in app/core/security.py + app/api/routers/auth.py + frontend auth: require authentication for every Dashboard page and API endpoint EXCEPT the WhatsApp webhook and /health; passwords hashed with Argon2id (or bcrypt cost>=12); session tokens expiring after 12h inactivity; RBAC for the six Roles (owner, manager, front_desk, department_staff, destination_official, admin) — department_staff see only their Department's Complaints; destination_official see only aggregated Destination views + Evidence_Packets (no Stay/Complaint records); every operational record (Stays, Complaints, Interventions, Property_Facts) scoped to a Home_Property with HTTP 403 cross-property; 5 failed logins within 15 min -> 15-min account lock + Audit_Log; serve over HTTPS in deployed environments (document TLS termination). Frontend: login page + session handling + role-aware navigation hiding/showing pages, all themed.

Guest PII protection (Req 31) in app/core/pii.py: encrypt guest phone/name/email/booking id at rest with AES-256 (or equivalent); the website masks phone numbers to last-4 for users without the manager Role; redact guest names/phones/emails/booking ids before any text is sent to the LLM adapter; delete voice-note audio 30 days after checkout keeping PII-redacted transcripts; delete/anonymise Stay PII 180 days after checkout (admin-configurable shorter retention); WhatsApp first-contact privacy notice + opt-out command handling (stop non-essential messages + Guest_Compass stops using the guest's data); keep application logs free of unredacted PII; demo uses synthetic guest identities/Stays and real data only for public reviews.

Audit_Log + secrets + API hardening (Req 32) in app/core/audit.py + config: append-only Audit_Log recording each login, failed login, Role change, unmasked PII view, Evidence_Packet generation, data export and retention deletion with user+timestamp+target; load all API keys/provider credentials from env/secrets store kept out of source control; validate all request bodies against declared schemas returning HTTP 422 with field-level errors; rate-limit LLM-backed endpoints to <=60 requests/min/user.

Metrics overview (Req 33) in app/services/common/metrics.py + the /(dashboard) home page: show reviews analysed, estimated reading hours saved (documented minutes-per-review assumption), median time-to-identification, category complaint trends, rating movement after Interventions, median complaint-to-department time, in-stay resolution rate, repeat-complaint count, recommendation uptake, ancillary revenue per guest, share of queries resolved without staff, number of Properties + Destinations benchmarked, and number of issues surfaced to authorities; make every metric clickable through the Drilldown; show the computation date + data window for each metric.

Demo readiness (Req 34) in scripts/ + Makefile: a SINGLE documented command (`make demo`) that loads the sample Mussoorie dataset, a Cluster of >=5 Properties, synthetic Stays and Property_Facts, runs model fits/changepoints/benchmark as needed, then starts the API + website; a scripted demo scenario (scripts/demo_scenario or a documented click-path in README) covering the What-If Simulator, Time Machine, Checkout Shield with a live (simulated) WhatsApp complaint, Playbook, Gap Finder, Destination heatmap + Evidence Packet, and the benchmark table; ensure the LLM-unreachable path falls back to template text labelled template-generated everywhere it is used. Create a seed module (app/seed/) building synthetic Stays/Property_Facts and demo users for each Role.

Final frontend polish pass (honouring the explicit user emphasis that the website look professional): audit EVERY page for consistent use of the green/white + forest + Mussoorie hill-town design system — spacing, typography, cards, charts, empty/loading/error states, responsive layout, a cohesive landing/overview, and clear navigation across all subsystems. Ensure the whole product is experienced as one polished website.

Update README.md with final architecture, the Deep-vs-Minimal map, the single demo command, demo user credentials (synthetic), the scripted scenario walkthrough, and a clear statement of which externals run as mocks/fallbacks in this environment. Run the full backend + frontend test/lint/build suite and fix any gaps.

Add pytest tests for auth (unauth 401 on protected routes, webhook+health public, 12h expiry, lockout after 5 fails), RBAC scoping (department_staff + destination_official + cross-property 403), PII (encryption at rest, last-4 masking by role, LLM redaction, log redaction), audit-log entries, 422 on invalid bodies, and the 60/min LLM rate limit. Add a frontend test for role-aware navigation and the metrics-overview drilldown.
acceptance_criteria: Every API endpoint and website page requires auth except /health and the WhatsApp webhook; passwords use Argon2id/bcrypt>=12; sessions expire after 12h inactivity; 5 failed logins in 15 min locks the account for 15 min with an Audit_Log entry (tested).

RBAC is enforced: department_staff see only their Department's Complaints, destination_official see only aggregated Destination views + Evidence_Packets, and cross-property operational-record access returns 403 (tested).

Guest PII is encrypted at rest, masked to last-4 for non-managers, redacted before LLM calls and absent from logs; voice audio deleted at 30 days, Stay PII deleted/anonymised at 180 days (admin-configurable); first-contact privacy notice + opt-out behaviour work; the demo uses synthetic guest data.

The Audit_Log records all required actions with user/timestamp/target; secrets load only from env/secrets store; invalid request bodies return 422 with field-level errors; LLM-backed endpoints are rate-limited to <=60/min/user (tested).
The metrics-overview home shows all required metrics with computation date + data window, each clickable through the Drilldown.

`make demo` loads the sample dataset + a >=5-Property Cluster + synthetic Stays + Property_Facts and starts the API + website with one command; the scripted scenario covers all required features; LLM-unreachable output falls back to template text labelled template-generated.
Every website page consistently applies the green/white + forest + Mussoorie hill-town design system and the product reads as one cohesive, professional website.
README documents the architecture, Deep-vs-Minimal map, the single demo command, synthetic demo credentials, the scenario walkthrough, and the mocked/fallback externals.
Full backend (`ruff` + `pytest`) and frontend (`lint` + `build` + `test`) suites pass.
verification: Run `cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest` and confirm all auth/RBAC/PII/audit/rate-limit tests pass.
Run `cd frontend && npm install && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` and confirm all pass.
Run the single `make demo` command and confirm it seeds data and starts the API + website, then walk the scripted scenario end-to-end (externals via mocks/fallbacks) without errors.
